req.title: Task ids are monotonically increasing
req.statement: The system shall assign strictly increasing integer ids to newly created tasks.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-034 requires that task IDs are strictly monotonically increasing integers. To verify this, we need: (1) a positive test confirming two sequential POSTs yield id2 > id1 with exact integer arithmetic; (2) a boundary test confirming the increment is exactly +1 (not +2 or +0) by checking id2 == id1 + 1; (3) a negative test confirming that invalid payloads (empty title) are rejected with HTTP 422 and do NOT consume an ID slot (the next valid task still gets the expected next id); (4) a state-transition test confirming monotonicity holds across N sequential creations; (5) a decision-table test confirming the property holds regardless of payload variation (different titles, descriptions, completed flags). All tests use in-process FastAPI TestClient with a fresh SQLite in-memory database to ensure isolation and determinism.

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

def test_sequential_ids_are_strictly_increasing():
    engine = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
    models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    TestingSession = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
    def override_get_db():
        db = TestingSession()
        try:
            yield db
        finally:
            db.close()
    app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
    client = TestClient(app)
    r1 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Task A", "completed": False})
    r2 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Task B", "completed": False})
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    assert r2.status_code == 201
    id1 = r1.json()["id"]
    id2 = r2.json()["id"]
    assert isinstance(id1, int)
    assert isinstance(id2, int)
    assert id1 > 0
    assert id2 > id1
    app.dependency_overrides.clear()

test_sequential_ids_are_strictly_increasing()

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

def test_monotonic_ids_across_n_sequential_creations():
    engine = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
    models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    TestingSession = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
    def override_get_db():
        db = TestingSession()
        try:
            yield db
        finally:
            db.close()
    app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
    client = TestClient(app)
    titles = ["Alpha", "Beta", "Gamma", "Delta", "Epsilon"]
    ids = []
    for t in titles:
        r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": t, "completed": False})
        assert r.status_code == 201
        ids.append(r.json()["id"])
    assert ids == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    for i in range(len(ids) - 1):
        assert ids[i + 1] == ids[i] + 1
        assert ids[i + 1] > ids[i]
    app.dependency_overrides.clear()

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

def test_ids_increase_regardless_of_payload_variation():
    engine = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
    models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    TestingSession = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
    def override_get_db():
        db = TestingSession()
        try:
            yield db
        finally:
            db.close()
    app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
    client = TestClient(app)
    long_desc = "X" * 500
    r1 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Buy groceries", "description": "A", "completed": True})
    r2 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Fix login bug", "completed": False})
    r3 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Write project report", "description": long_desc, "completed": True})
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    assert r2.status_code == 201
    assert r3.status_code == 201
    id1 = r1.json()["id"]
    id2 = r2.json()["id"]
    id3 = r3.json()["id"]
    assert id1 == 1
    assert id2 == 2
    assert id3 == 3
    assert id2 == id1 + 1
    assert id3 == id2 + 1
    assert id1 < id2 < id3
    app.dependency_overrides.clear()

test_ids_increase_regardless_of_payload_variation()

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

def test_title_at_max_length_boundary_accepted_and_id_increments():
    engine = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
    models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    TestingSession = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
    def override_get_db():
        db = TestingSession()
        try:
            yield db
        finally:
            db.close()
    app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
    client = TestClient(app)
    title_100 = "A" * 100
    title_101 = "A" * 101
    r_ok = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": title_100, "completed": False})
    assert r_ok.status_code == 201
    assert r_ok.json()["id"] == 1
    r_bad = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": title_101, "completed": False})
    assert r_bad.status_code == 422
    r_next = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Follow-up", "completed": False})
    assert r_next.status_code == 201
    assert r_next.json()["id"] == 2
    assert r_next.json()["id"] == r_ok.json()["id"] + 1
    app.dependency_overrides.clear()
